intro.text: One of a band of former parshmen freed by the Everstorm, with an Alethi name and accent.

items.text: Ton was among the former parshmen who held Kaladin captive. As they argued over what to do with him, Ton asked Khen if she could kill him; she said she would if it were needed to keep her freedom. Kaladin was unsettled that they had Alethi names and accents.
